name: models.dev
measures: Which AI models have open weights
about: models.dev is an open catalogue of AI models and the services that sell them, kept by the makers of OpenCode and its contributors. We use it to tell which models Epoch AI tested on SWE-bench Verified have open weights, then compare the best open and closed scores.
limitations: Its flags are edited by contributors and can be wrong.
Models it doesn't list are left out of the comparison.
attribution: Calculated from models.dev and its git history, as of 2026-11-01. MIT License.
